reviewScope: All 73/73/73/97 frames in complete sequential light/dark contact overviews; six native tile-size start/apex/recovery detail views per action on both backgrounds; native cheer palm source frame 30 before/after.
notClaimed: Not independent human review, not a full-resolution manual examination of every pixel, not mathematically exact head rotation, not lossless RGB WebP, and not guaranteed every-frame delivery on physical phones.

paletteRepair.scope: Cheer fists only: 31 PNG frames with exact alpha and exact outside-mask pixels before encoding.
paletteRepair.maskMethod: Label neutral-bright components on the whole image before source-specific hand-side bbox filtering. Do not reuse waving hand coordinates or clip the face into a component ROI.
paletteRepair.temporalRepair: The first 24-frame correction candidate omitted some hands above y=365. It was not deployed. v2 includes the complete raised-hand region: both fists are corrected on every source frame 19 through 40.
paletteRepair.compressionDisclosure: Quality-92 WebP may slightly change RGB outside the palette mask; each tile opaque-pixel RGB mean error is bounded to 3 levels and alpha is exact.

nod.meaning: 温和点头、表示明白或确认
nod.note: Shallow head-forward inclination with closed eyes and a small smile; distinct from the deeper already-released thanks bow. No head-only scaling or layer translation applied.

thinking.meaning: 指尖近下巴、查找记录或稍作思考
thinking.note: A short blink on recovery remains a provider variation. Hand/sleeve connections and the completed lowering phase are retained.

cheer.note: Warm fist color no longer alternates to uncorrected white at the apex. Cheerful closed-eye curves are retained; they are not substituted for the separately refined idle blink.

yawn.note: Covered-mouth opening, eye closure and complete arm recovery remain from the full-figure source. No separate hand or mouth composite.

observations.runtimeAndActualResourceChecks: Require a matching browser-local/report.json; this art record alone cannot authorize a different source or atlas.
